body:
The maintained design-system guide now documents the complete shared motion vocabulary: timing/curve/distance/blur tokens, card/dialog/menu/Calendar layers, desktop/mobile behavior, readiness and navigation keys, bounded effects, cleanup and reduced motion. The documentation index links directly to it, the user guide has a motion/accessibility section, and the browser guide includes focused Chromium/WebKit commands.

Package/document links, section anchors, documented timing values and suite commands were checked. Application behavior and the previously verified rollout are unchanged. Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-soft-motion.md, Documentation handoff.

metadata.summary: Complete motion system documentation is maintained and indexed
